questions.q: What is the default file extension for a PowerPoint presentation?
questions.x: The default file extension for PowerPoint presentations saved in the newer format is **.pptx** (since 2007).

questions.q: Which PowerPoint view allows you to see all slides in a thumbnail format?
questions.x: Slide Sorter View displays all slides as thumbnails for easy rearrangement.

questions.q: What is the maximum zoom percentage available in MS PowerPoint?
questions.x: The maximum zoom level in PowerPoint is **400%**, useful for detailed editing.

questions.q: Which tab contains the 'Handout Master' option in PowerPoint?
questions.x: 'Handout Master' is found under the **View** tab for customizing print layouts.

questions.q: Which animation effect is used to make text appear on a slide one word at a time?
questions.x: The **Typewriter** effect simulates text appearing as if typed, word by word.

questions.q: Which of the following is a real-time operating system (RTOS)?
questions.x: FreeRTOS is designed for real-time applications requiring deterministic timing and response.

questions.q: What is the full form of 'GUI' in the context of operating systems?
questions.x: GUI stands for Graphical User Interface, which allows users to interact with electronic devices through visual icons.

questions.q: Which operating system was developed by Microsoft specifically for servers?
questions.x: Windows Server is designed by Microsoft to manage network resources, user accounts, and security for businesses.

questions.q: Which of the following is a feature of a multi-user operating system?
o: Supports only one user at a time
Allows multiple users to access the system simultaneously
Runs only on a single CPU
questions.x: A multi-user OS enables multiple users to interact with the system at the same time, sharing resources like CPU and memory.

questions.q: Which command is used in Linux to create a new directory?
questions.x: The `mkdir` command in Linux is used to create a new directory in the filesystem.
